subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Fierce
solution: The correct answer is **"Gentle."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Fierce"** means having or displaying an intense or ferocious aggressiveness. (क्रुद्घ, आक्रामक और डरावना; बर्बर) • **Example**: *The house was guarded by **fierce**__ dogs.* • **"Gentle"** means having or showing a mild, kind, or tender temperament or character. ((व्‍यक्ति) दयालु और शांत; बिना चोट पहुँचाए कोमलता से व्‍यवहार करने वाला; सौम्‍य) __ • **Example**:* ‘I'll try and be as **gentle**__ as I can,’ said the dentist.* • Therefore, the antonym of **Fierce** is** Gentle**. • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, Sore**, means painful or aching. ((शरीर का अंग) दुखता हुआ (विशेषतः छुए जाने पर)) • **Option 3, Vast**, means of very great extent or quantity; immense. (बहुत बड़ा, विशाल, विस्‍तृत) • **Option 4, Noisy**, means making or given to making a lot of noise. (शोर मचाने वाला; शोर-भरा, कोलाहलपूर्ण) 3f:Tb01, The correct answer is **"out of the blue."**
